name: tosu-lyrics-proxy
description: Minimal loopback proxy for the tosu Live Lyrics overlay.

scripts.build: pkg src/server.js --target node18-win-x64 --output dist/lyrics-proxy.exe && pkg src/start-tosu.js --target node18-win-x64 --output dist/Start-Tosu-Lyrics.exe && copy /Y bilibili-blacklist.txt dist\bilibili-blacklist.txt >nul
